payload.title: Filtering through queries
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates the use of the PyLiPD Python package to filter LiPD formatted datasets based on various criteria such as archive types, location, variable names, time intervals, proxies, and resolution. The notebook provides a step-by-step guide on how to load datasets, apply different filtering methods, and manipulate data using the LiPD and LiPDSeries objects. The Euro2k database is used as a sample dataset to illustrate these filtering techniques.
